description: Wash sale detector — Detects IRS wash sales (26 USC 1091) in a trade list, offline: FIFO lot matching, losses disallowed when identical shares are bought within 30 days before or after a loss sale, disallowed amount added to the replacement lot's basis with holding period tacked, Form 8949 code W, short/long term, and open lots with adjusted basis. Required: trades = semicolon-separated rows date,side,symbol,qty,price[,fee] (up to 500). Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_wash_sale
